## Agile Engineering Process (5 Stages)
- **URL:** https://alphaaiservices.in/company/process
1. Deep Discovery & Technical Feasibility (System architecture, PRD, security matrix)
2. Interactive UX & Architectural Prototyping (Clickable prototype, DB schema)
3. Rapid Agile Sprints & Production Milestones (Bi-weekly demo releases, automated testing)
4. Hardening, Automated Security & Deployment (Load testing, SOC2 checks, zero-downtime CI/CD)
5. 24/7 Telemetry, Observability & Warranty (Post-launch warranty hypercare, metrics dashboard)
